task1.title: Request for Information
task1.prompt: You recently moved to a new city and want to learn about local attractions and activities. Write a letter to a friend who has lived in the city for some time. In your letter, ask for information about the best places to visit, any upcoming events you should attend, and what the city is known for. Also, mention your plans for visiting and express your excitement about exploring the new surroundings. Make sure to include your new address so they can write back to you easily.

task2.title: The Impact of Technology on Communication
task2.prompt: In recent years, technology has significantly altered the way we communicate with each other. While many argue that technology has improved communication, others believe it has made it worse. Discuss both views and provide your own opinion. To what extent do you agree that technology has improved communication? Support your argument with relevant examples.
